text:
kevin: spun up RC from main: service:v1.14.1-rc0 at 1790009999. Build passed CI, artifacts uploaded. Planning to promote in the 90m change window (start at T+45m). Requesting quick +1 from SRE/QA.

deploybot: Artifact: redwood-inference/service:v1.14.1-rc0
sha256: b7c9d1f...
bake: 8m
canary plan: 5% -> 25% (10m) -> 75% (25m) -> 100% (30m)
promote command: `deploybot promote --image redwood-inference/service:v1.14.1-rc0 --env prod --pin rc-1.14.1-0`

anya: quick check: staging smoke green. One non-blocking warning in the model cache init logs but perf looks stable.

pat-qa: QA: running full regression now. Found intermittent alignment-check test failing under heavy batching. Not sure if it's RC-specific. Will attach logs.

meera-sre: FYI infra is scheduling a small kernel micropatch at T+30m to fix a scheduler latency tail. Recommend we pin the artifact and delay final promo until we validate after the patch.

kevin: agree with pin & hold. Can we pin and reserve within promo window so it doesn't GC?

deploybot: `deploybot pin --image redwood-inference/service:v1.14.1-rc0 --tag rc-1.14.1-0 --retain 72h` -> acknowledged.

oliver: suggestion: run a KV prefill before canary to avoid cold-cache p50 spikes. Script: `curl -sS https://internal-warm/prefill -X POST -d '{"count":2000}'`

meera-sre: rolling micropatch at T+30m now. Will monitor NVMe and scheduler latencies. Abort plan: rollback patch and hold promo if p95 > 200ms or error rate doubles.

pat-qa: re-ran the flaky alignment-check after pin; still seeing the failure locally on a single shard. I'll instrument more and report. Could be a model-serving concurrency edge.

kevin: okay, plan: keep RC pinned. After micropatch stabilizes, run KV prefill, then run smoke + focused e2e. If QA signal OK, proceed with canary. If QA still sees failing shard, we block promo and either hotfix or postpone to next window.

deploybot: pre-canary checklist queued: 1) KV prefill 2) prefix cache restore 3) create canary slice 4) enable health probes

meera-sre: micropatch applied. Observability: scheduler tail-latency p95 dropped 260ms -> 120ms over 6m. NVMe stable. Good to run KV prefill.

oliver: kick off warm now.

deploybot: Running KV prefill -> count=2000, estimated 90s.

pat-qa: re-run focused e2e during warm. alignment-check now PASS in 3/3 runs. QA +1 conditional on canary metrics.

kevin: launching canary after warm. @meera-sre & @oliver monitor.

deploybot: Canary started: 5% traffic. Baseline compare engaged.

meera-sre: 15m into canary: no error spike, scheduler p95 consistent, no increase in CPU steal.

oliver: tokenization warnings from earlier not reproduced in canary. Good.

pat-qa: canary regression suite green. QA final +1.

deploybot: Ramp to 25% -> OK.

kevin: we'll hold at 25% for 20m then continue ramp if clean. Any objections?

anya: none from product side. Release notes: note the alignment-check fix and mention low-risk warning about cache init.

meera-sre: holding watch until 100%. If any threshold breach (p95 > 200ms or error spike > 2x baseline) we abort and rollback to previous image.

deploybot: Ramp to 75% -> metrics within thresholds.

kevin: prepping changelog PR and tagging release. I will finalize notes after 100% promo.

deploybot: Finalizing promotion: `deploybot promote --image redwood-inference/service:v1.14.1-rc0 --env prod --pin rc-1.14.1-0 --finalize`

meera-sre: 100% reached. No incidents.

kevin: Promotion successful. Release notes draft: v1.14.1: stability improvements to scheduler tail-latency, alignment-check flakiness mitigated; note: cache-init warning observed in some staging runs (monitoring). Pinned rc-1.14.1-0 for 72h for rollback.

pat-qa: I pushed repro logs to the ticket and linked the changelog PR.

anya: thanks team, closing out. :tada:
